api_base.description: PromptGuard API base URL. Defaults to https://api.promptguard.co. Falls back to PROMPTGUARD_API_BASE env var.

api_key.description: API key for PromptGuard authentication. If not provided, the PROMPTGUARD_API_KEY environment variable is used.

block_on_error.description: Whether to block the request when the PromptGuard API is unreachable. Defaults to true (fail-closed). Set to false for fail-open behaviour.
